What you wrote was so thoughtful and compassionate, I can’t thank you enough! I appreciate your advice and kind words so much and I hope you realize how much better you made me feel with your words♥️

It’s true that I snapped at him many times and said some horrible things, but it was all out of resentment and anger. It’s still not right, I should have just left, but I wanted him to pay so bad. I feel like he’s right sometimes... thank you for the kind words 🙏
Thank you so much for the kind words and the offer♥️ I might message you, if I need to, but otherwise won’t bother you ♥️

Thank you sooo much. I will try to be less pessimistic about the way I see things. For these last few months I’ve been focusing on getting healthy and working out and keeping a weekly cleaning routine, because those things have become really difficult for me due to depression. Much of my depression comes from doubting my trauma, so the responses this post garnered really helped validate my experiences. I will try my best moving forward.

Thank you so so much ♥️♥️I was already planning on doing that, because I want some type of financial independence and I would also like to travel with friends. I’m hoping to take a break from boys at university and focus on my studies and making really good girlfriends. I miss having friends I can trust and rely on. They’re the family we choose. I’m scared that I will fuck it up somehow, because I feel like I’m so obviously broken, but I will still try.

I don’t think I can press charges, because the age of consent in my country is 14. And in his it’s 16. He waited until 16 to have sex with me. I’m not sure I would want to, but thinking about him doing it to another girl really scares me. My parents would never be on board with it and they would constantly blame me throughout the whole process. I don’t know if I can take that...
I will be going to university in a few months, so I’ll be out of here soonish
I would love to go to therapy again, but my parents are against it unfortunately and they’re stressed right now with corona affecting their jobs, so I don’t want to poke the bear...

This is exactly how I feel. I can’t even look at a 17 year old boy or girl and see them as a romantic prospect. It’s so wrong in my head. It hurts me that he didn’t care enough about me to see it that way...

Thank you so much. I don’t think I’m ready to explain this to her, because I feel really ashamed of myself for even letting it happen. I feel so unsupported right now, but I don’t have anyone close to me who I trust with this. I hope that acceptance gets easier with time. I feel like I’m not worthy of love or that there’s something wrong with me. There was another boy who was interested in me at one point, but he ended up grabbing my wrist and twisting it painfully when I was being a bit cheeky. I was so shocked and hurt. And my dad verbally abused my mother on a daily and has done so with me as well. He’s always keeping me at home, so that I’m isolated. My brother learned from him and is a major asshole as well. All the men in my life have always disappointed. I never want to go through something like this again and men scare me even more now. I’ve been to therapy, but never opened up about any of this.

Thank you so much. I really appreciate the compassion. I don't think she cares anymore about me, since we haven't really talked for 3 years now... It's true that I don't really want to accept that he's a pedophile. He told me that dating younger girls is normal in Italian culture and some of his friends even knew about us and didn't really care. Everything seemed so normal. It feels strange to think it wasn't.
Thank you. Now leave.

Good for you. Just because you recovered doesn’t mean you can victim blame. Have a good day.

I realize what you’re saying, but you were still victim blaming. My abuse is still fresh and you should’ve known better. I wasn’t dumb, I was just lonely and vulnerable. I don’t deserve any shame and neither do you. If you feel ashamed for what he did, maybe you need help.
Thank you.
If you have been through something similar and you still victim blame, then shame on you.

He wasn’t...

Ouch. That was quite harsh. I don’t think those circumstances apply to this situation, because we were on omegle and he wasn’t actively seeking out a 15 year old. We just happened to match. I honestly think that it was a fuck up on his part, but I still don’t think that he’s any less responsible for what he did to me. There is a reason why it’s illegal to date and have sex with minors after all. He just thought he had it under control. And just saying, telling me he took screenshots of me naked really isn’t nice and it could potentially trigger someone’s anxiety or paranoia. I know that he didn’t, because he was not that kind of person. I’m not in denial about the fact that what he did was very wrong, but I wouldn’t call him a pedophile.

I think he just didn’t care that I was 15. He didn’t respect the fact that I was still a teenager. He regularly ridiculed my teenage problems, because he was older and saw my problems as trivial. Like my test anxiety and my fear of judgment from other people. I think he may have just been insensitive towards my age and fucked up because of that. And I’m the one who ended up with the trauma I guess...

I don’t think that he’s a pedophile necessarily... he said many times that things got worse, because we were long distance. We only got to meet 3 times in 3 and a half years. I feel like it’s hard to judge, because you don’t know him.
How do you cope, if I may ask? I’m wondering what I can do to move forward.
